source_meta._title: Allays assigned to a player can be set on fire with sweeping and fire aspect

stor.environment: Minecraft Java Edition 1.21 Pre-Release 3 in a new, unmodified singleplayer world. Use Creative mode with commands/cheats available for deterministic setup, then change to Survival mode before the triggering attack. Use keyboard and mouse controls; the listed keys assume default bindings.
preconditions: Launch the exact affected version listed as Minecraft Java Edition 1.21 Pre-Release 3, not a later release or either listed fix version.
Create a disposable singleplayer world in Creative mode with commands available. A flat preset is optional but can make entity placement easier.
Use an open, level area with a solid block beneath the player and enough room for an allay and a cow.
Do not install mods or datapacks that alter combat, allay behavior, enchantments, entity immunity, or attack cooldowns.
The player must be standing on the ground, not sprinting, not jumping, and must allow the sword attack cooldown to become fully charged before the trigger.
The commands below must be entered in in-game chat with the leading slash. If command feedback reports insufficient permission, recreate the world with commands enabled.
After selecting the setup position, avoid walking away from it: the entity summon coordinates are relative to the player's position.

steps.action: Load the new world using Minecraft Java Edition 1.21 Pre-Release 3 and wait for world initialization to finish.
steps.success_cue: The player can move normally, nearby terrain is rendered, and the pause menu identifies the running version as 1.21 Pre-Release 3.

steps.action: Move to an open, level area, stand on a solid block, and stop moving. Remain at this position through the setup so the relative summon coordinates stay usable.
steps.exact_input: W/A/S/D as needed, then release all movement keys
steps.success_cue: The player is stationary on level ground with at least three blocks of unobstructed space nearby.

steps.action: Summon a stationary allay slightly more than two blocks from the player. Press T to open in-game chat, enter the exact command including the leading slash, and press Enter. The NoAI tag is used only to prevent the allay from leaving the controlled test position.
steps.success_cue: Command feedback indicates that an allay was summoned, and one allay is visible approximately two blocks from the player.

steps.action: Obtain one cobblestone item to assign the allay to the player. Open in-game chat, execute the exact command, and press Enter.
steps.success_cue: A cobblestone item is present in the player's inventory or hotbar, and command feedback reports that the item was given.

steps.action: Select the hotbar slot containing the cobblestone. The hotbar is the row of nine item slots at the bottom of the screen; use the corresponding number key or the mouse wheel until that slot has the selection outline.
steps.exact_input: Hotbar number key 1-9 or mouse wheel
steps.success_cue: Cobblestone is visible in the player's main hand and its hotbar slot is highlighted.

steps.action: Aim the crosshair directly at the summoned allay and use the item on it once to give it the cobblestone. With default controls, use means right-click.
steps.success_cue: The cobblestone leaves the player's hand and is visibly held by the allay, establishing that the allay has been assigned to this player.

steps.action: Without changing the player's position, summon a stationary cow as the primary attack target. Open in-game chat, execute the exact command, and press Enter. The cow will be placed next to the assigned allay so the allay is within the sword's sweeping area.
steps.success_cue: A cow is visible approximately two blocks from the player, with the item-holding allay immediately beside it.

steps.action: Obtain a diamond sword. Open in-game chat, execute the exact command, and press Enter.
steps.success_cue: A diamond sword is present in the player's inventory or hotbar, and command feedback reports that the item was given.

steps.action: Select the hotbar slot containing the diamond sword by pressing that slot's number key or using the mouse wheel.
steps.exact_input: Hotbar number key 1-9 or mouse wheel
steps.success_cue: The diamond sword is visible in the player's main hand and its hotbar slot is highlighted.

steps.action: While the diamond sword remains selected in the main hand, apply Fire Aspect I. Press T, enter the exact enchant command including the leading slash, and press Enter.
steps.success_cue: Command feedback reports that Fire Aspect was applied to the selected sword; the sword remains selected and has the enchanted-item glint.

steps.action: Change the player to Survival mode for the combat action. Open in-game chat, execute the exact command, and press Enter.
steps.success_cue: Command feedback reports that the game mode was set to Survival, and the health and hunger bars are visible above the hotbar.

steps.action: Without pressing movement, sprint, jump, or attack, rotate the camera until the crosshair is centered on the cow's body. Confirm visually that the cobblestone-holding allay remains immediately adjacent to the cow rather than between the crosshair and the cow.
steps.exact_input: Move mouse only; do not press W/A/S/D, Left Ctrl, Space, or left-click
steps.success_cue: The crosshair is on the cow, the adjacent allay still visibly holds cobblestone, and the player remains stationary on the ground.

steps.action: Keep the crosshair on the cow and wait at least one full second without attacking. This ensures the sword attack cooldown is fully charged so the next grounded, non-sprinting sword attack can produce a sweeping attack.
steps.exact_input: Wait at least 1 second with all attack and movement controls released
steps.success_cue: At least one second has elapsed since any attack, the player is still grounded and stationary, and the cow and assigned allay remain adjacent.

steps.action: Attack the cow exactly once with the fully cooled Fire Aspect sword while remaining grounded and stationary. With default controls, attack means left-click. Do not click a second time.
steps.success_cue: One sword attack input has been delivered to the cow while the assigned, item-holding allay is still within the sweeping area beside it.

stor.handoff_condition: The player has just completed one fully cooled, grounded, non-sprinting attack against the cow with the Fire Aspect sword while the item-holding allay is immediately adjacent. Begin observation immediately after this single attack and do not perform another attack.
uncertainties: The report lists 24w33a both under affected versions and fix versions. The plan follows the required ordering rule and uses the first affected version, 1.21 Pre-Release 3.
The report does not specify a particular target mob; a cow is used as a deterministic, non-hostile implementation of the report's generic instruction to attack a mob.
The report does not require Sweeping Edge, so the plan adds only Fire Aspect I and relies on the normal fully charged sweeping attack performed by a grounded, non-sprinting player wielding a sword.
The NoAI entity tag and exact relative placement are deterministic setup aids inferred for automation; the report itself only requires an assigned allay to be within range of the sweeping effect.
